'''2007 Dagobah Regionals Frank Lam LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Frank Lam]] at [[2007 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Frank Cam
* '''Deck name:''' Light Combat
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
